# A plan whose acceptance criteria are prose

## Goal

Say what this task is for, in one sentence a reader can disagree with.

## Requirements

- One requirement, stated so that a test could be written against it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The first criterion is written as a bullet with no checkbox, which is the measured defect: the file cannot say
  what is done.
- The second criterion is written the same way.

## Out of Scope

- Anything this task does not do.
